lines.text: David son of Jesse, anointed by the God of Jacob, speaks his last words as the sweet psalmist of Israel.
David says the prophet Nathan spoke through him, and his word was on his tongue.
The Rock of Israel says a ruler who rules with justice in the fear of God is like morning light.
David says God established with him an everlasting covenant, ordered and secured in every part.
David says the worthless are like thorns raked aside, touched only by a man armed with bronze or a spear shaft.
